profile.org_note: Founder-run, single-office private builder with no divisions and no published leadership page; the three 'areas' on the website are sales groupings, not divisions with presidents. Taber LeBlanc (Owner and President) makes the land calls himself and develops land through his affiliate Premium Land, LLC; a COO (Travis Davidson) runs operations. No CFO, controller, treasurer or land executive is named in any public source found. A 2018 company release called his father-in-law John Alexander, a long-time Oklahoma City land developer, a partner in the business; whether he still holds a stake is not public. HQ on the company site is 305 West Memorial Rd, Ste A-2, Oklahoma City 73114 (Builder magazine lists Edmond).
profile.summary: Private, founder-owned Oklahoma builder (founded 2000) that calls itself the state's largest: 633 closings in 2025 per the Builder 100, after a peak of 883 in 2021 per the company, selling from 29 listed communities, almost all around Oklahoma City, with a small Tulsa presence since 2022 and one community near Stillwater. A conventional for-sale builder aimed at move-up and first-time buyers. It is a developer-builder: the owner buys and develops most of its own land through an affiliate rather than buying finished lots, and nine of the 29 communities are in 'coming soon' or 'grand opening' status, so new land is being brought on now.

people.name: Taber LeBlanc
people.title: Owner and President
people.source_title: Homes by Taber: About the Home Builder (company site)
people.note: Founder (June 2000) and the only owner the company names; the site styles him Owner and President, while the Builder 100 listing shows him as CEO (seen in a search snippet only, builderonline.com blocks fetches). He is the land decision-maker: the company's own history says he personally finds and develops the land, and his land entity Premium Land, LLC is the named applicant on plats for Taber communities (City of Moore minutes of 2021-03-09 read 'Premium Land LLC/Taber LeBlanc'). No separate land head or finance head is published, so land-bank conversations start with him. Phone is the company main line.
